item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q005_cupredoxin_function_transfer","answer":"In the current public SCOPe release, 2.08, all three named groups are in class b, All beta proteins; fold b.6, Cupredoxin-like; and superfamily b.6.1, Cupredoxins. They are separated below that superfamily: azurin/plastocyanin exemplars such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa azurin d1azua_ are family b.6.1.1, Plastocyanin/azurin-like; the murine ephrin-b2 ectodomain d1ikop_ is family b.6.1.5, Ephrin ectodomain; and the human PAD4 N-terminal domain d1wd8a2 is family b.6.1.6, Peptidylarginine deiminase Pad4, N-terminal domain.
